meta.title: Codex ↔ DSH Project Bridge
meta.description:
Local Codex ↔ DSH messages, status and controlled conversation creation. Enable the plugin, configure Codex and register a project; see README.en.md.

Install and enable dsh-xsession for same-workspace DSH peer messages; workers/reviewers can retain the app permission defaults. Cross-project messaging requires another suitable plugin.

No automatic task dispatch or privilege elevation. DSH full access requires explicit configuration. Prefer native creation by an existing Codex conversation; CLI creation does not guarantee sidebar visibility.
